structure: batch-outer (16 batches); identity [128,128] loaded once into SBUF; per batch load rhs[b] resident [k=64(par), n=4096(free)] once (16 KB/part), sliced per n-chunk; per m-tile (32 = 4096/128): load lhs tile [m_in=128(par), k=64(free)], identity-transpose ONCE via nc_matmul(is_transpose=True, is_moving_onezero=True) -> PSUM [k=64(par), m_in=128(free)], copy to SBUF; then 8 n-chunks of 512: SINGLE-PASS K=64 main matmul nc_matmul(stationary=lhs_t[64,128], moving=rhs[64,512]) -> [m_in=128(par), n=512(free)] PSUM (NO K-accumulation loop, K=64<=128 fits one Tensor-Engine pass), copy into a resident score[128,4096] SBUF tile. Then FULL-ROW (4096-wide) fused softmax over the N free axis entirely in SBUF: row_max[128,1]=tensor_reduce(nl.max, score, axis=[1]); neg_max[128,1]=tensor_scalar(row_max, op0=nl.multiply, operand0=-1.0); exp_t[128,4096]=activation(op=nl.exp, data=score, bias=neg_max[128,1], scale=1.0); row_sum[128,1]=tensor_reduce(nl.add, exp_t, axis=[1]); recip[128,1]=reciprocal(row_sum); out_t[128,4096]=tensor_scalar(exp_t, op0=nl.multiply, operand0=recip[128,1]); one 4096-wide store into direct 3D output out[b, 128*mt:+128, :]. fp32 throughout; NO softmax op on a PSUM tile (all reduce/activation/elementwise read/write SBUF score/exp/out tiles; PSUM banks only hold matmul/transpose, copied out immediately).
arg_roles: v1=lhs (16,4096,64)=(B,M,K); v2=rhs (16,64,4096)=(B,K,N); out=(16,4096,4096)=(B,M,N), reshapes row-major to the reference (16,4096,4096). Reference transform_to_nki_inputs is reshape-only (natural batched layout); reference forward = softmax(lhs@rhs, axis=2) over N.
